review: Read-only operational review after orphan and SIGTERM fixes
initial_blocker: Supervisor restart could duplicate a surviving child; SIGTERM did not clean owned child
disposition: Fixed: saved active PID plus process start time checked before restart; live owned orphan refuses execution; SIGTERM raises into owned-child cleanup. Existing attached process can be reattached intentionally.
limits: SIGKILL cannot run cleanup; resume therefore fails closed when a recorded owned child remains alive.
Terminating supervisor while attached to an external initial inference process leaves that attached process running; its owner must stop it explicitly.
Source hashes are checked before each stage, and completed stages use their recorded success guards.
